title: Thomas–Fermi asymptotics for growing atomic ionization number
exact_target: For integer $Z>m\geq 1$, define $I_m(Z)=E(Z-m,Z)-E(Z,Z)$ for full nonrelativistic Coulomb atoms with two spin states. Does $I_m(Z)/m^{7/3}$ approach the positive Thomas–Fermi constant $a_TF$ whenever m$\to$infinity and Z/m$\to$infinity? Require the same constant for the iterated m$\to$infinity limits of fixed-m Z-limsup and Z-liminf, without asserting any fixed-m convergence.
